title: ‘You ask us for peace, we get shot in the face’: Minneapolis in turmoil after federal agents kill second US citizen
summary: Federal agents released chemicals into the air and arrested people after they had shot and killed a 37-year-old man Minneapolis shooting – latest updates Man believed to be 37-year-old US citizen shot and killed by federal agents in Minneapolis “I’m 70 years old and I’m fucking angry,” the man yelled as clouds of chemicals hung in the subzero air in Minneapolis , capturing the sentiment of a city that’s now seen two people killed by federal agents in less than three weeks. Agents shot and killed a 37-year-old US citizen at about 9am on Saturday, with other observers watching and videotaping their actions, in an area called Eat Street, a corridor of largely immigrant-owned restaurants and businesses.
